items.translation: A real possibility (also présent or impératif in the result)
items.exampleFr: Si tu viens, je serai content.
items.exampleEn: If you come, I will be happy.

items.translation: An unreal or unlikely situation now
items.exampleFr: Si j'avais de l'argent, j'achèterais une voiture.
items.exampleEn: If I had money, I would buy a car.

items.translation: A regret or an unreal past
items.exampleFr: Si tu étais venu, tu aurais vu le film.
items.exampleEn: If you had come, you would have seen the film.

items.translation: No futur or conditionnel directly after si (if); si + il(s) = s'il(s)
items.exampleEn: If it rains, I am staying.
